TEN.name: Dorian Mausi
TEN.detail: The Titans activated Mausi (foot) from injured reserve Monday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

TEN.name: Tony Pollard
TEN.detail: The Titans opted not to move Pollard ahead of Tuesday's trade deadline, despite him drawing interest from teams, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

TEN.name: Nicholas Singleton
TEN.detail: Titans head coach Robert Saleh said Monday that Singleton is "getting better," and the rookie running back could be a candidate to see added opportunities in the second half of the season if lead back Tony Pollard is dealt ahead of Tuesday's deadline, Turron Davenport of ESPN.com reports.

TEN.name: Calvin Ridley
TEN.detail: Titans head coach Robert Saleh confirmed Monday that Ridley was involved in an "unfortunate" interaction over the weekend at Nashville International Airport that is now in the hands of law enforcement, Cameron Wolfe of NFL Network reports.

TEN.name: Joey Slye
TEN.detail: Slye hit both field-goal tries and his two extra-point attempts in Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals.

TEN.name: Elic Ayomanor
TEN.detail: Ayomanor caught three of five targets for 34 yards in Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals.

TEN.name: Chimere Dike
TEN.detail: Dike caught five of six targets for 61 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals.

TEN.name: Gunnar Helm
TEN.detail: Helm caught five of nine targets for 76 yards during Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals.

TEN.name: Wan'Dale Robinson
TEN.detail: Robinson caught six of seven targets for 57 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals. He also lost a fumble.

TEN.name: Cam Ward
TEN.detail: Ward completed 26 of 40 passes for 304 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals. He added seven rushing attempts for 41 yards, lost a fumble, ran in a two-point conversion and threw a successful two-point conversion.

TEN.name: John Franklin-Myers
TEN.detail: Franklin-Myers (groin) is active for Sunday's game against the Bengals, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.

WSH.detail: Burks (foot) doesn't have an injury designation for Thursday night's game against the Giants.

WSH.name: Colson Yankoff
WSH.detail: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn ruled out Yankoff (knee) for Thursday night's games against the Giants, Ben Standig of The Team 980 Washington D.C. reports.

WSH.name: Dyami Brown
WSH.detail: The Commanders placed Brown (calf) on injured reserve Saturday.

WSH.name: Daron Payne
WSH.detail: Payne (foot) underwent season-ending surgery Wednesday, Ben Standig of The Team 980 Washington D.C. reports.

WSH.name: Jeremy McNichols
WSH.detail: McNichols, who suffered a foot injury Sunday against the Eagles that may require surgery, is out for the season, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

WSH.name: Sonny Styles
WSH.detail: Styles recorded 13 tackles (six solo) during Sunday's 20-13 loss versus the Rams.

WSH.name: Nick Cross
WSH.detail: Cross recorded eight tackles (six solo), an interception and a fumble recovery during Sunday's 20-13 loss versus the Rams.

WSH.name: Frankie Luvu
WSH.detail: Luvu recorded 15 tackles (seven solo) including 1.0 sacks during Sunday's 20-13 loss versus the Rams.

WSH.name: Chig Okonkwo
WSH.detail: Okonkwo (hip) was a full participant in Tuesday's walkthrough practice.

WSH.name: Antonio Williams
WSH.detail: Williams caught three passes for 25 yards on six targets in Sunday's 20-13 loss to the Rams.

WSH.name: Drew Stevens
WSH.detail: Stevens made both of his field-goal attempts and his only PAT during Sunday's 20-13 loss to the Rams.

WSH.name: Austin Ekeler
WSH.detail: Ekeler rushed eight times for 16 yards and caught two of three targets for 18 yards during Sunday's 20-13 loss to the Rams.

WSH.name: Van Jefferson
WSH.detail: Jefferson caught five of seven targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 20-13 loss to the Rams.

WSH.name: Stefon Diggs
WSH.detail: Diggs caught three of five targets for 51 yards in Sunday's 20-13 loss to the Rams.

WSH.name: Rachaad White
WSH.detail: White carried the ball seven times for 28 yards and caught two of three targets for 41 yards in Sunday's 20-13 loss to the Rams.

WSH.name: Jayden Daniels
WSH.detail: Daniels completed 24 of 35 passes for 274 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 20-13 loss to the Rams. He also gained 16 rushing yards on four carries and lost a fumble.
